My first elder scrolls game was Oblivion. When I first started playing I didn't know about fast travel (I'm not sure if there was a tutorial prompt, but I skipped all that stuff anyways). I ended up playing a portion of the game without fast travel, it was pretty awesome discovering all these little things that you would miss by fast traveling.
That's what I'm getting at, playing Skyrim without fast travel was a great experience. It allowed you to search ever cave, kill every ogre. It was great.
